about: WastePlanner's legal documents: the ONE place their versions and effective dates live. The text is legal/terms.md and legal/privacy.md (file names are relative to this file); terms.html / privacy.html render it and the app reads the versions from here for sign-up and acceptance. Change a document = edit its .md and its version/effective here, in one commit. publishedAt: accounts created on or after this day that never ticked the sign-up box are asked to accept at once (null = nobody is asked; set 2026-10-20 by Lachy's decision). reacceptFrom: the day existing users must accept the current versions (the effective date the notice email gave; the v2.0 notice went to 5 accounts on 2026-10-20 for 2026-11-20). Dates are YYYY-MM-DD, Australia/Melbourne.
